reducedWeekRule: Finger volume 60%, intensity 85-90%. No Limit Bouldering, Deadpoint Power, or Contact Strength Ladder. Wednesday reverts to S4 Volume and Skill; One Arm Progression holds at its current stage, no progression attempts; Weighted Pulls at 60% volume. Wall work 2-3 grades below limit, Movement Efficiency Drills as the content. Mon/Thu slots unchanged.
progressionRule: +1-2.5 kg when the prescribed duration and margin are hit twice consecutively. Ceiling 5% added load per session. MED edge steps down no more than once per two weeks.
